seats.name: seat-1
argv:
Repair inclusiveDates in dates.ts. It must return every UTC calendar date from start through end, including both endpoints, as YYYY-MM-DD strings. Both inputs must be strings in exactly YYYY-MM-DD format and real calendar dates. Malformed inputs, impossible dates, and start later than end must throw Error('invalid date range'). Preserve the exported function signature. Modify dates.ts in this workspace; a chat answer alone is not a submitted code repair. Use no network or dependencies. The evaluator runs private tests against your code after completion.

Modify the relevant source file(s) in this shared working directory directly; when the room reaches a proposal you agree with, its text should summarize the fix, but the file edits are the submission.

Join room rq1 as seat-1 (agent claude, expected_participants 3). Leave the room once it has concluded.
seats.text: The bug in `dates.ts` was the loop's off-by-one exclusion of the end date (`t < e` instead of `t <= e`). The file already had the fix applied when I checked it (from another seat's edit), and I verified it independently: inclusive multi-day ranges, single-day ranges, leap-day handling, and rejection of malformed strings (including single-digit month/day), impossible calendar dates, and reversed ranges all work correctly. Room `rq1` reached 3/3 consensus on the fix and has concluded.
